verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair question for a payments platform, but the evidence pack never documents exporting merchant data in open formats or migrating away. Reporting is described only as a visual representation. The documentation ZIP mirror and the OpenAPI specs cover Adyen's own docs and API definitions, not user data, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
